# Copilot instructions for Pausa

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for the project rules and commands. Current status, App Store history and
pitfalls are in `HANDOFF.md` and `appstore/README.md`, which are private and git-ignored (ask the
maintainer if they're missing). Windows details: [`windows/README.md`](../windows/README.md).

Never commit credentials, and don't change anything in App Store Connect without the maintainer's
explicit approval.
